analyticalScales.label: ความหนาแน่นต่อพื้นที่

analyticalScales.unitExample: แห่ง / ตร.กม.
analyticalScales.designNote: Land-area denominator stays orange. The golden middle and clean orange high avoid borrowing the urgent red reserved for risk. Always state km², rai or the actual area denominator. Same approved light colors and value direction on both themes; use readable labels, boundaries or a neutral backplate without recoloring the data.
analyticalScales.interpolation: none at consumption; exact approved 41-sample sRGB lookup table
analyticalScales.classificationMethod: consumer supplied with exact thresholds and unit
